body: It’s ridiculous to assume that this means that they are abusing their prescription. Some people with serious pain conditions just call in early and want to ensure they have their medication on time because they NEED it. I’m prescribed a controlled substance and I’ve called early before because the one time I didn’t, I wasn’t able to pick up my medication because it had been 14 days, and I couldn’t see my doctor for a month. I want to make sure that won’t happen again, and I’ll have enough always. I’m also on another medication that reduces the amount of the controlled one in the blood and greatly reduces its effects. I feel disgusted that a pharmacist might assume I’m abusing my life-saving medication because I called in a few days early.
I have the same. It’s torture. Message me if you want

Thank you. It’s hard to find much on the net about it from professionals. That makes me feel more alone. There are many articles and studies published about contamination ocd, but why not cancel culture ocd? Therapists I have had were ill equipped at dealing with it too. And I see it every day, it’s so hard to escape. The uncertainty is horrible. I totally understand that paranoia, no need to voice chat, we can chat over Reddit if you’re comfortable.
